feeds.title: Beating Sugar Blog
feeds.description: Get help with sugar addiction, stress eating, emotional eating. Dan DeFigio, author of Beating Sugar Addiction For Dummies offers tips, resources, and nutrition coaching.

feeds.title: SHiFT Blog
feeds.description: A leader in the groundbreaking field of food addiction treatment, SHiFT - Recovery by Acorn supports people to lift themselves out of the depths of food obsession. SHiFT Recovery programs are for people in all stages of recovery, be it just beginning, in relapse, or long-term.

feeds.title: Molly Carmel Blog
feeds.description: Overcome binge-eating, food addiction, and emotional eating. Molly is an addiction and eating disorder therapist. She provides articles on Health & Wellness, Sugar Addiction, Weight Loss, Mental Health, Diet Culture, Behavioural Therapy, and Exercise.

feeds.title: Fork In The Road Blog
feeds.description: A website dedicated to sharing resources & tips on Low-Carb Eating and Sugar Addiction. Author Jen Unwin shares interesting research findings & new developments in the field of food addiction.

feeds.title: Edible Addiction Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts cover Food Addiction, Emotional Eating, Food Cravings, Healthy Food Habits, Mindset, and Inspiration. Dr. Kirsten Grant is a researcher, speaker, consultant. Her passion is helping women that struggle with food addiction and food addiction symptoms.
